name: moomooinvest-dashboard
description: Static DCA dashboard (dashboard/index.html) plus tiny serverless APIs: api/ticks.js and api/notes.js store checked-off buy rungs and per-rung notes in a small database so they sync across devices, and api/quote.js fetches live market prices on demand so the page isn't limited to the daily close committed by GitHub Actions. api/push.js and api/notify.js send Web Push notifications when a buy rung or sell target is reached.
